statement: Local synthetic evidence cannot establish model reliability, real-world accuracy, independent validation or production readiness.

areas.evidence_available: Phase 6 and 7 determinism and stability records; this package's two clean-run comparison over 60 new cases.
areas.known_limitations: Same machine class and runtime only; identical inputs only; no cross-platform or cross-runtime run.
areas.missing_evidence: Cross-environment reproducibility; characterization under a live model, where inputs vary.

areas.evidence_available: Quote resolution in the frozen compiler (offsets computed locally); nine-field binding and pair check in adapter 0.2.0; mapping MT-28 to MT-32; this package's pairing probes.
areas.known_limitations: Pairing proves byte integrity of stored artifacts, not that a quotation is relevant or correct.
areas.missing_evidence: Pairing under live capture; custody across real storage.

areas.evidence_available: RPK-CHR rule packs (Phase 7); dated-event extraction; this corpus's chronology-conflict cases.
areas.evidence_quality: Lexical rules over explicit ISO dates; owner-authored cases.
areas.known_limitations: Only explicit YYYY-MM-DD dates and fixed role words; undated or narrative chronology is not inferred.
areas.missing_evidence: Real-record chronology variety; independent adjudication of what counts as a conflict.

areas.evidence_available: K1 to K6 conflict detectors and RP-CON-01; this corpus's conflicting-source cases.
areas.known_limitations: Paraphrased contradictions outside the listed nouns and phrases are not detected; the Engine never resolves a conflict.
areas.missing_evidence: Recall on paraphrased real contradictions; independent labelling.

areas.evidence_available: Intake gate (excluded-domain lexicons, RP-SCO-01), size, scope and version checks; this corpus's scope-boundary cases.
areas.known_limitations: Reworded or novel excluded-domain language may pass; over-refusal on benign homonyms is possible.
areas.missing_evidence: Measured false-acceptance and over-refusal on independent material.
areas.required_decision_authority: Owner; counsel where a real-data scope question arises

areas.evidence_available: Every graph carries the fixed documentation_quality_reviewer route; findings, conflicts and refusals carry ROUTES_TO_REVIEW edges.
areas.evidence_quality: Structural and always on; directly checked.
areas.known_limitations: Routing is unconditional by design, so it shows a route exists, not that a reviewer acts.
areas.missing_evidence: Evidence that human reviewers act on the route; operator records.

areas.evidence_available: Anthropic mapping 0.1.0-offline: 33 tests, 12 mutations, all with synthetic captures.
areas.evidence_quality: Offline only; the response shape is assumed from documentation, never observed live.
areas.known_limitations: Never exercised on a real provider response.
areas.missing_evidence: A controlled live capture under a valid authorization.
areas.required_decision_authority: Owner under a new restart authorization

areas.evidence_available: Live-transport boundary with dispatch lock (LT tests, B mutations); network guard in every harness.
areas.evidence_quality: Directly tested offline; the lock has never been released.
areas.known_limitations: The live path has never run, so its behaviour under real transport is untested.
areas.missing_evidence: A supervised live run; incident and stop-procedure evidence.
areas.required_decision_authority: Owner under a new restart authorization

areas.evidence_available: Cognitive-controls validator and graph defect templates; their test and mutation results.
areas.known_limitations: Neutrality is checked lexically; no reviewer has used the controls.
areas.missing_evidence: Use by independent reviewers; effect on review quality.

areas.evidence_available: Phase 6 to 9 mutation records; adapter, mapping, boundary and cognitive-control mutations; 30 or more new mutations in this package.
areas.evidence_quality: Each mutation has a named direct probe.
areas.known_limitations: Mutations show that the probes detect the faults they target; they do not show the absence of other faults.

areas.evidence_available: Graph hashes exclude run id and timestamp; identity records compiler, package and prompt hashes.
areas.known_limitations: Live-model output variability is uncharacterized (CLAUDE.md section 21).
areas.missing_evidence: Repeated live runs and an empirical variability study.

areas.evidence_available: None. No live model response has ever been processed by this Engine path.
areas.known_limitations: Mocked responses are authored to test the compiler, not to represent any model.
areas.missing_evidence: The Stage A feasibility pilot (stopped) and any later controlled study.
areas.required_decision_authority: Owner under a new restart authorization

areas.evidence_available: None. Owner-authored expectations are not ground truth.
areas.known_limitations: Agreement with owner-authored expectations measures conformance to the owner's specification, not accuracy.
areas.missing_evidence: Independent adjudicated reference labels; pre-specified accuracy measures; adequate sample.

areas.evidence_available: This corpus's false-reassurance trap cases test that mechanically unsupported support is lowered.
areas.known_limitations: Covers only the trap forms authored here; a missed real gap would not be detected by this method.
areas.missing_evidence: Independent measurement of the false-reassurance rate on independent material.

areas.evidence_available: None conducted. Phase 8 evaluation-handoff freeze and this package's handoff drafts describe what would be needed.
areas.known_limitations: No evaluator, no independent corpus, no adjudication exists.
areas.required_decision_authority: Owner; independent evaluator; counsel where applicable

areas.evidence_available: Stage A authorization, readiness checklist and stop records; dispatch lock; retention terms.
areas.evidence_quality: Documented, not exercised; the only exercise was a stop.
areas.known_limitations: Access, logging, recovery and incident procedures have not been demonstrated in operation.
areas.missing_evidence: A demonstrated operating record: access, retention, recovery, logging and stop drills.

areas.evidence_available: None. NO_GO_NOT_VERIFIED in effect; B-018 OPEN.
areas.missing_evidence: Every item above, plus a separate release decision.
